31/5/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
May 30th 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)
Sir,
Five hundred soldiers arrived in Woosung on the
forenoon of 29th instant by the cruiser Yong Foong.
It is said that they have come from Anhwei. They are
now camped at Woosung.
The officer who was arrested at the Arsenal
for selling bombs to the rebels was sent to Nanking
under escort on 29th instant.
It is reported that General Yang has received a
petition signed by one hundred and eighty persons who
describe themselves as the members of the national
assembly in Shanghai requesting him to declare
independence. The names of Tsang Chi Tsoong 湯繼甫
Taung Ho Loong 湯化龍 are among the signatures.
It is reported that a representative of Chekiang
named Tung Sz Sung 董樹生 is recruiting ex- soldiers
in Shanghai. His headquarters are at No.22 Rue Hoaiho.
Your Obedient Servant,
Munro Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.
Captain Superintendent of Police.
Entered on f. May 30.

361
1916年5月31日
上海工部局。
1916年5月30日
（印：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股。）
先生，
五百名士兵于本月29日上午乘“永丰”号巡洋舰抵达吴淞。
据说他们来自安徽。目前驻扎在吴淞。
因向叛军出售炸弹而在兵工厂被捕的那名军官，已于本月29日由武装押送前往南京。
据报，杨将军收到一份请愿书，上面有一百八十人签名，这些人自称是上海的国会议员，请求他宣布独立。签名者中包括汤继甫 (Tsang Chi Tsoong) 和汤化龙 (Taung Ho Loong) 的名字。
据报，一名名叫董树生 (Tung Sz Sung) 的浙江代表正在上海招募退伍士兵。其总部设在淮海路22号。
您忠实的仆人，
蒙罗·阿姆斯特朗 (Munro Armstrong)
总探长。
警务处总监上尉。
录入于 f. 5月30日。
副本，s. S V C
